scenarios.name: should resolve import aliases
scenarios.given: default, named, and namespace HTTP or child_process imports
scenarios.then: the original client and method are identified while unrelated and shadowed bindings are skipped

scenarios.name: should select actual options positions
scenarios.given: Axios body methods, config-only calls, fetch, or subprocess optional argv
scenarios.then: request payloads and argv are not treated as option objects

scenarios.name: should ignore unrelated methods
scenarios.given: a client factory, dynamic call, or unsupported namespace member
scenarios.then: no supported IO call is inferred
